title: Reward Model Confidence Calibration as a Signal for Misspecification

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: calibration as a diagnostic for reward model misspecification is a reasonable hypothesis. But the link between calibration quality and downstream alignment is indirect and may not hold empirically.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires training reward models, computing calibration metrics (ECE, reliability diagrams), and correlating with downstream policy alignment. The full RLHF pipeline is complex for beginners even with libraries like TRL.
